en: You know: this rumor is TRUE
zh: 你知道：这条传闻是真的

en: You know: this rumor is FALSE (you planted it)
zh: 你知道：这条传闻是假的（你造的谣）

en: Keys: Q = BELIEVE (Buy Call), W = BULLSHIT (Buy Put), E = PASS
zh: 按键：Q = 相信（买入看涨），W = 扯淡（买入看跌），E = 观望

en: Copying %s: you place the same bet
No cash left for a bet. Sell something first.
zh: 没现金下注了，先卖点东西吧。

en: Stake: %s (%d%% of your net worth, paid now)
zh: 下注：%s（占净资产 %d%%，立即扣款）

en: Boss stake: %s (%d%% of your net worth)
Insider tip: tomorrow's rumor is TRUE
zh: 内线消息：明天的传闻是真的

en: When it resolves it is stamped as planted. Nobody learns by whom.
zh: 揭晓时会被标为被操纵，没人知道是谁干的。

en: Your flip is used up until the next quarter.
zh: 翻转已用完，下个季度恢复。

en: No tip today. It comes on one random day each quarter.
zh: 今天没有消息。每个季度会随机有一天。

en: DOUBLE DOWN comes after the reveal.
zh: 加倍下注要在揭晓后使用。

en: Double down used: it comes back next quarter.
zh: 加倍下注已用，下个季度恢复。

en: You were FIRED. Your run ends here.
zh: 你被炒鱿鱼了，游戏到此结束。

en: %s was FIRED at the quarter review
Quarter %d is over: your skills are back
zh: 第 %d 季度结束：技能已恢复

en: New BOSS rumor: you can bet on it for the next 3 days
zh: 新的Boss传闻：接下来 3 天可以下注
你排第 %d 名（共 %d 人）

en: Trading fees: On (change it in Settings)
zh: 交易手续费：开（可在设置中更改）

en: Trading fees: Off (turn them on in Settings)
zh: 交易手续费：关（可在设置中开启）

en: A small fee on every trade in the table game. Off by default. Applies from the start of your next run.
zh: 牌桌模式每笔交易收一点手续费。默认关闭，从下一局开始生效。

en: Nothing has resolved yet. Every verdict lands here.
zh: 还没有结果。每条裁决都会记在这里。

en: Your three rivals are drawn at random

zh: [Q] 相信   [W] 扯淡   [E] 观望   [Esc] 稍后再说
你持有 %d 股，平均成本 %s

en: You hold none of this stock
The day resolves by itself after the reveal. Off: you press Next.
zh: 揭晓后当天自动结算。关闭后需要你点“下一步”。

en: The day resolves in a moment...
COPILOT: copying %s today (change it on the rumor card)
zh: 跟投：今天抄 %s（可在传闻卡片上更改）

en: COPILOT: pick a rival to copy on the rumor card
zh: 跟投：在传闻卡片上选一位对手来抄

en: No call yet: this counts as PASS
The market is closed. Trading is only open before the after-market.
zh: 已休市。盘后之前才能交易。

en: Press Next to finish the day
Plays the intro of a new run (about 25 seconds). Space skips it.
zh: 新一局开始时播放（约 25 秒），按空格可跳过。

en: Half the cash went into %d shares of %s, bought at its low. They can never be sold.
zh: 一半现金在低点买入了 %d 股 %s，永远不能卖出。

en: %s doubles the option: +%s more at stake.
Your skill is used up until the next quarter.
zh: 你的技能已用完，下个季度恢复。
